text_block_list.text:
One day, while organizing the trainer's office...
I found a "Hot Springs Trip Voucher."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Then promise me.
Promise that if I work hard,
you'll take me to the hot springs.
She's worked so hard over these past three years. And so—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! So this is the inn
where we'll be staying tonight!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
What a charming and tasteful building!
This really raises my expectations for the hot springs♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, Trainer Reporter.
What's the matter? You look almost like—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You look completely worn out, as if you were made to pack
everything for your trainee's trip and then had to hustle
around taking care of her the entire way.
Yes, up until this point—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—A hot springs trip!
You're finally taking me on one!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'll go ask Hishi Ama-san!
choice_data_list: If you need permission to go out, I can—
If you need permission to go out, I can—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: No, not that. Permission to bring things from the room down to the dorm entrance.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You promised to take care of meeemee for
eeevery single thing during our trip, right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Before it even begins,
I'm gonna be completely and thoroughly spoiled~♪
...And so, starting with sorting through the mountain of luggage she brought in—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san~.
I'm hungry-.
choice_data_list: I'll go buy some station bento boxes.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yay!
Please throw in some milk too, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san~.
The chair is too hard, I can't sleep~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Dat is not enough.
Lend me your shoulder~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You mustn't move even a single millimeter, okay~...?
*Zzz...*

"...After tending to many other requests,
she finally made it to the inn."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Phew, thanks to you, Trainer,
it ended up being a really comfortable trip♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nyahaha~, you're really wiped out, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Then let's hop right into the hot springs!
We can take a long, relaxing soak and soothe all that fatigue away~
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Haah~...♪
That was a mighty fine bath, wasn't it~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Sei-chan wants to stay here forever~
I'm gonna be a hot spring inn kid~."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~?
You meanie.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Then, Trainer, please go strike a hot spring
near the academy!

"...She's asking for far more unreasonable things than usual.
It seems Seiun Sky came today fully intending to be thoroughly pampered."
choice_data_list: Got it, let's talk to the Chairwoman about it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wait, really?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Ummm.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Asking me so straight-up like that
really puts me on the spot~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...For now, standing around talking isn't great, so
why don't we go rest in a room?

"And so, I chatted idly with
Seiun Sky for a while, but—"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: *Yawn*...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...
It's so nice and warm...
choice_data_list: Then I'll walk you back to your room.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...H-Huh?
That's weird.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: My head feels kinda... floatier than usual.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Trainer-san,
would you mind touching it to check?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: It's fine, it's really not a big deal.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...You can ruffle my hair
all you want, okay?"

Giving in to Seiun Sky as she waits in silence,
I give her head a gentle, thorough ruffle.
Her soft, fine hair felt wonderfully fluffy.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—See, it was fluffy, right?
I'll have you know it's widely praised as being very pettable.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you got to
fluff around, aren't you~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Mm!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'm really glad I have such an honest
and kind Trainer supporting me.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, who knows?
Maybe it just means you're easy to manage, which is a relief?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nihehe~...♪

It was a moment where I felt an irreplaceable
bond between Seiun Sky and myself...
